Когато по основателна причина участник не е в състояние да представи поисканите от възложителя документи, той може да докаже своето икономическо и финансово състояние с помощта на всеки друг документ, който възложителят приеме за подходящ. В случай, че финансовите отчети са обявени в търговския регистър в пълен обем, участниците не ги представят. normalized.title: X-Ray Diffraction system
normalized.description: An X-ray scattering measurement goniometer setup is sought for the characterization of the structure and morphology of a wide scope of solid materials and especially battery materials under operando conditions. The setup should include the optics to perform X-ray diffraction and total diffraction (PDF) with an Ag X-ray source. This is required for operando transmission studies of thick solid samples (several mm). The aim is to combine diffraction studies (phase transitions, strain etc) with morphology studies (homogeneity, porosity, grains/pores size statistics, grain boundary dynamics) on the same samples. For this reason the setup should combine X-ray diffraction with X-ray computed tomorgaphy (CT), the latter with a spatial resolution of at least 5 micrometer.
